notes: F always exists before effects; absence refuses, never runtime upsert. Account/region/full engine binding checked from owner installation. All updates only closed D issuer/migration functions.
Epoch and generation highwater strictly increase; revision CAS increases; restore/reset only externally reconciled new incarnation, never automatic opening.
No authority from controller_state/observation digest alone: protected issuer has independently authenticated actual external/controller and DB state before checkpoint.
G immutable core equals approved GenerationCore canonical bytes and column projections; candidate decision uses CandidateDecision, runtime uses ActivationDecision, no digest cycle.
Unique global login_name and login_oid within D installation; unique secret_resource; resource lifetime nonreuse enforced against external owner tombstones too. No DELETE/TTL; RETIRED is terminal.
One live current generation per F; PREPARED->OPEN->RETIRED or PREPARED->RETIRED only. Retirement clears cached admission proof/deadlines, never erases immutable provenance.
F points to G by generation_id; current runtime operations require same incarnation+epoch. Retirement can select older G under current F without changing historical G epoch.
Quiescence stays UNPROVEN until actual routes/in-flight admissions/sessions/pools/prepared transactions close; RETIRED alone never means quiescent.

Unique permit_id installation-wide; no reuse. Exact caller login+task+logical request+purpose+epoch binding. Read-purpose permit can read current-authorized receipt while runtime ACTIVE; effect permit only CLOSED quiescent fence.
Only issuer inserts/revokes. TTL expiry never deletes, grants new permit, proves transaction terminal or unlocks runtime.
F->permit->provisioning receipt; receipt lookup before absent-only historical before-state.

Primary key deliberately excludes epoch/permit/digest/incarnation: same logical run cannot create a second effect by changing attempts. Original database binding remains receipt provenance; authorized restored-history read checks actual scope lineage.
Immutable receipt inserted in native effect transaction; no update/delete/TTL/cascade, no true commit timestamp claim.
canonical_result_bytes is exact approved DeployResultBody/GrantResultBody W1 bytes, never generic JSON; full NativeReceipt bytes validated against projected columns.

Full current authorization/F/G checks precede lookup. Same current operation+digest returns exact receipt; changed request conflicts. A historical open receipt does not bypass RETIRED/current epoch checks.
Generation operations contain exact approved IssuerReceipt; fence/permit/checkpoint operations have closed storage-specific result described in CONTRACT, never masquerade as IssuerReceipt.
No after-commit append, deletion, TTL, same-ID second namespace or FK cascade.
Component literal maezo-d7-control; initial D component version=1 and migration ID maezo-d7-control-0001. This does not allocate tenant Alembic/global native version numbering.
Append-only owner migration receipt. Package expects exact head/version/predecessor/digests; no MAX(version) or CREATE IF NOT EXISTS acceptance. Any pre-existing unowned relation/name refuses.
role/object manifests contain exact known runtime OIDs/function signatures/owners/ACLs and externally supplied identities after owner installation; placeholders cannot be admitted. No secret values.
Six tables only; full owner configuration is closed bounded records, not ad hoc SQL or text authority.
D schema owner alone INSERT; guard/issuer-function owners SELECT, no UPDATE/DELETE; all other direct access absent.

Global lifetime preparation_id selects exactly one PREPARED and optional one NATIVE_QUALIFIED and one REMOVED, in that order (NATIVE_QUALIFIED optional for removed never-opened generation). No replacement birth, no tombstone deletion.

Partial unique indexes on login_name, login_oid and resource_identity_sha256 WHERE event=PREPARED; full identity bytes also compared against digest collisions. Existing external lifetime resource tombstones also required.

Owner operations lock scope F, affected G then installation V row for cross-scope name/OID/resource serialization, then owner receipt. Never hold V and acquire F/G. Bounded complete inventory <=1024 lifetime PREPARED events; no truncation.

Repeated preparation is verification/recording of externally owner-prepared actual resources, never caller-triggered role creation. REMOVED preserves original name/OID, requires proven terminal closure plus actual absence; old identity reappearance refuses.

third_repair_rules: StoreCall top-level and ResultEnvelope constants/fields unchanged; this explicitly supersedes unimplemented operation-specific v1 allocation, not a silent stage1 protocol edit. All sibling generation requests remain exact two-field records.

Retire parsing uses existing IssuerRequest schema, then storage-specific current request/F authority and historical full generation/decision validation separately. Do not call check_issuer_request with mismatching old-generation epoch/run, do not modify that pure predicate.
revoke_permit sets recorded one-shot NOLOGIN and revokes its exact CONNECT in same transaction with permit REVOKED and issuer receipt; already terminal exact replay performs no mutation.

No new SQL caller endpoint for owner preparation. Fixed owner installer operation via actual schema-owner migration session owns new receipt INSERT; no runtime or issuer-login EXECUTE privilege added.

OwnerInstallationInput.roles: array exact {role_class,role_name}; exactly one each singleton: D schema owner, D guard-function owner, D issuer-function owner, D receipt-function owner, actual issuer login, native function owner, scoped D observer login. No generation or one-shot class here.
OwnerInstallationInput.issuer_scopes: array<=1024 full approved Scope; exact DB binding/account/region; no wildcard scopes
OwnerInstallationInput.notes: Owner-authenticated protected input; parsing never confers permission. Existing expected role names must be actual owned prerequisites, unowned collision refuses.
OwnerInstallationInput.prepared_principals: array 0..1024 OwnerPreparationInput; repeatable generation and one-shot classes; role/name/OID/resources globally unique for lifetime; full actual receipt produced per entry

RoleAclManifest.roles: RoleCatalogEntry array, exact full protected-role inventory
RoleAclManifest.memberships: MembershipEntry array, complete relevant recursive closure; no truncation/nulls
RoleAclManifest.object_grants: ObjectGrant array, exact role/function/table/column/schema privileges, no implicit PUBLIC path
RoleAclManifest.operational_principals: exact array {purpose,native_actor,login_name,login_oid}; purpose deploy|grant|receipt_read, each binds actual seeded non-human native operational principal
RoleAclManifest.catalog_sha256: SHA256 of W1 manifest body excluding only catalog_sha256, never self-referential; actual catalog inputs and owner validation still required

RoleCatalogEntry.types: name=pg_name; oid=actual Oid; remaining rol* fields strict booleans

MembershipEntry.types: actual OIDs and strict booleans; PostgreSQL16 options checked independently

ObjectGrant.types: function_argument_types and column_names are exact arrays, empty when irrelevant; all names owner-verified, no caller SQL; grantee_oid>0. Any actual PUBLIC grant to the governed D surface makes admissible manifest validation fail; preserve offending catalog privately.

ObjectCatalogEntry.types: nullable function-only fields only for tables/schema; function exact properties from FUNCTIONS; names/OIDs actual catalog; definition_sha256 hashes qualified normalized catalog declaration under pinned serializer, separate raw SQL source hash retained

InstallationBinding.types: existing D aliases; actual OIDs and externally qualified controller table ARN/region, no placeholders

OwnerPreparationInput.principal: GenerationPreparationTarget or OneShotPreparationTarget; actual OID is catalog output, never input

GenerationPreparationTarget.types: exact approved GenerationCore fields except scope/epoch from envelope and login_oid from actual catalog; task_definition_revision is full approved TaskDefinitionBinding

OneShotPreparationTarget.types: owner-verified fixed native actor Id and resource_identity is the complete nonsecret immutable Id retained in input/result and external owner custody; SHA256 canonical {scope,kind,purpose,resource_identity}, collision checked by full equality; digest no authority

OwnerPreparationResult.principal: input principal plus actual login_oid; historical identity retained for removal
OwnerPreparationResult.generation_core: full actual approved GenerationCore for generation, explicit null for one_shot
OwnerPreparationResult.owner_catalog_bytes: exact full bounded RoleAclManifest current snapshot for PREPARED; verified event readback for other events
OwnerPreparationResult.authority: actual separate D owner migration session and qualified external owner resource readback; record or hash alone grants nothing

OwnerPreparationEventInput.terminal_proof_bytes: non-null retained existing external owner full terminal/quiescence proof only REMOVED

NativePrincipalQualificationBinding.authority: DEPENDENCY: exact byte receipt from separately qualified native-owner preparation operation, not currently implemented or authorized by D packet. D verifies through owner-bound native readback; fields never grant native authority.

global_constraints: All records reject unknown/missing keys; scalar W1 types and UTF8/size bounds apply. All arrays sorted uniquely by full tuple in declared field order, max1024; exceeded visibility refuses.
No secret material or password/certificate private key has a field. Signatures/profile validation stay at their exact separate trust boundary.
role_class does not grant a role: actual owner migration authority+catalog reads produce RoleCatalogEntry and ACL evidence.
Every runtime/native/worker/issuer-login path to owner SET/INHERIT/ADMIN is absent; issuer-function-owner ADMIN only to its enumerated owner-prepared target roles.
No PUBLIC grants to D namespace/tables/functions. Required privileges are exact; extras to untrusted roles fail readback.

Only actual owner migration output can populate MZO_PROVISIONING_SCHEMA_VERSION and its bytea/digest projections. Consumer also compares installed catalogs and pinned expected package; table content alone is insufficient.

Maximum1024 lifetime prepared principals per installation across initial and later owner events; exceeded bounds refuse. New owner preparation does not consume/rewind generation ID; controller must reserve monotonically before owner preparation and preserve failed reservations.

Preparation field names and nested typed values are closed; canonical complete bytes <=1MiB, arrays<=1024 and W1 depth<=64. Each event actual catalog compares full prior overlay, then own exact delta. No nullable success on missing external/native qualification.

third_repair_catalog_matrix.immutable: all role attributes except rolcanlogin; all recursive ADMIN/INHERIT/SET/grantors, owners, OIDs, definitions/properties, fixed ACLs exact; owner-recorded later prepared targets extend inventory without rewriting earlier snapshot
third_repair_catalog_matrix.PREPARED: rolcanlogin=false, direct/effective CONNECT absent; all fixed privileges equal owner birth
third_repair_catalog_matrix.OPEN: rolcanlogin=true, exact direct CONNECT edge granted by pinned issuer-function owner; protected G OPEN + matching committed open/admit issuer receipt + native qualification where native-facing; no other catalog delta
third_repair_catalog_matrix.RETIRED: rolcanlogin=false, exact CONNECT edge absent; corresponding protected retirement receipt, old open receipt cannot justify reopening
third_repair_catalog_matrix.PERMIT_ISSUED: rolcanlogin=true, exact CONNECT edge; current protected ISSUED permit with matching issue receipt; expiration stops guard authority without pretending catalog autoupdate
third_repair_catalog_matrix.PERMIT_REVOKED: rolcanlogin=false, exact CONNECT edge absent; revoked_by_issuer_operation_id references exact current revoke or whole-scope handoff receipt; latter request expected old owner covers revoked permit epoch/run
third_repair_catalog_matrix.REMOVED: historical complete OID/name/birth snapshot retained; qualified terminal proof plus actual role/resource absence matches REMOVED event; name/OID/resource reincarnation always refuses
third_repair_catalog_matrix.NATIVE_ACL: only native owner-qualified exact generation-specific ACL delta to fixed existing native objects; native birth receipt immutable. Unqualified extra native grant refuses. No broad allowlist or ignored ACL fields.
